name: Tessera Industries Ghostweave Infiltration Suit
description: A full-body suit woven from Tessera's electromagnetic-absorbing metamaterial fibers that renders the wearer nearly invisible to thermal imaging, radar, and passive electromagnetic sensors. The Ghostweave does not provide optical invisibility — you can still be seen with the naked eye — but against the sensor suites that constitute modern security systems, the wearer effectively does not exist. The suit absorbs 99.2% of incident electromagnetic radiation across thermal and radar bands, and its inner surface includes a conductive mesh that contains the wearer's own electromagnetic emissions. In a world where detection relies on sensors rather than eyes, the Ghostweave makes someone a ghost.

specifications.EM containment: Inner conductive mesh suppresses wearer emissions
specifications.info: worn under clothing; metamaterial degrades in machine washing

story_hooks: A Ghostweave suit was found at a break-in scene — the suit had been compromised by a chemical agent that caused the metamaterial to fluoresce on security cameras instead of absorb, turning the intruder's stealth suit into a beacon.

Tessera is tracking Ghostweave suits by embedding a unique EM signature in each suit's weave that is detectable by Tessera's own sensors — buyers think they are invisible, but Tessera always knows where they are.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, form-fitting bodysuit with an iridescent quality that shifts between deep charcoal and matte black depending on viewing angle. The fabric has a subtle geometric tessellation pattern visible in certain light, suggesting the metamaterial weave beneath. Despite its technical sophistication, it appears almost textile-like in drape and flexibility.
physical_description.dimensions: Full-body coverage garment; approximately 180 cm long when laid flat, designed to conform to the human form
physical_description.weight_description: Lightweight and pocketable when compressed; 1.8 kg total weight allows easy carrying or wearing under standard clothing without bulk
physical_description.primary_material: Tessera electromagnetic-absorbing metamaterial fiber composite; inner conductive mesh layer
physical_description.finish: Matte with subtle iridescent sheen; surface displays fine tessellation patterns (geometric honeycomb-like weave) visible under direct light; smooth, almost liquid-like texture
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: deep charcoal to matte black with hints of dark purple iridescence; Accent: silver conductive mesh visible at seams and internal surfaces
physical_description.interface_elements: Minimal — discrete reinforced seams at joints; small Tessera Industries label patch at interior neckline; subtle size markings in silver thread; no visible fasteners, buttons, or ports
distinctive_features: Iridescent tessellation pattern that catches light at certain angles
Nearly imperceptible geometric weave structure across entire surface
Seamless integration of inner conductive mesh visible at stress points
Ultra-thin profile suggests advanced material engineering
Subtle shimmer that seems to absorb rather than reflect ambient light
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Small embossed Tessera Industries logo (geometric tessera pattern) at interior collar; 'GHOSTWEAVE INFILTRATION SUIT' printed in silver on care label; manufacturing date and serial number on interior tag; 'Vasquez Biocompatible Materials' origin stamp
physical_description.condition_typical: When worn, appears as a second skin beneath clothing; subtle geometric pattern visible through thin outer garments; in storage, the suit drapes with unusual fluidity, almost liquid-like; no creasing or wrinkles visible despite packing
